title: Warner Bros. Japan Launches Looney Tunes Gokko Short Anime
content: The official YouTube channel of Warner Bros. Japan started streaming on April 29 a trailer for a new short anime based on Looney Tunes characters titled Looney Tunes Gokko . Warner Bros. Japan then debuted the short anime's first episode the next day, on April 30.
author: ANN

title: Tekken 8 Game Reveals Gameplay Trailer for DLC Character Kunimitsu
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed the gameplay trailer for DLC character Kunimitsu for its Tekken 8 fighting game on Sunday. English Japanese Season 3's DLC characters include Kunimitsu, Bob, and Roger Jr., along with one other unannounced character. Bob will launch in summer and Roger Jr. in fall.

title: Black Clover Ends With an Unexpected Rivalry
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Black Clover manga! After 11 years of serialization, Yuki Tabata’s beloved action-fantasy series Black Clover is closer to its finale than ever. The manga entered its Final Arc in 2022 before transitioning to Shueisha’s Jump GIGA magazine on a quarterly schedule.
author: ComicBook

title: Major Shonen Jump Series Heads Towards Finale After Only 2 Years
content: Launched in 1968, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump eventually became the best-selling manga magazine of all time thanks to the popularity of several memorable series, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , and many more.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Breaks Silence on Modulo’s Final Release: “I Am Proud to Have Created Modulo”
